findings.title: AccrueInterest Reentrancy & ExchangeRate Stale State
findings.description: Exchange rate calculation depends on cash, borrows, and reserves which must be accrued prior to any mint/redeem/borrow operation.

attackSurface.attackVector: Interacting with cToken via flash loan before accrueInterest is called could theoretical execute on stale interest index.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
